office.name: Secretary Office
office.reception_role: Everyone here looks after their own part of the server. Just ask.
agent.away_title: The agent on the server is not running.
agent.away_text: You see the last known state; nothing can be changed until it is back.
protect.offsite_text: local snapshot + Kopia, encrypted off the server
protect.local_text: only a snapshot or dump on this server — gone with the server
errors.bad_request: The request could not be read.
errors.agent_away: The agent did not pick up the request — is it running?
errors.agent_busy: The agent is still working on it. Try again in a moment.
errors.pin_wait: Too many wrong tries. Wait {seconds} s.
errors.auth_storage: The office can't store the PIN — the folder data/office is missing or not writable. Is the agent running?
auth.locked: Locked — reading only. Click to unlock.
auth.unlock_text: This office is protected. Enter the PIN to change things; this browser stays unlocked for 12 hours.
auth.settings_text_off: Anyone in your LAN can change things at the moment. With a PIN, the office stays readable for everyone, but deleting, starting a backup and the like need the PIN.
auth.settings_text_on: Changing things needs the PIN. Change it here, or remove it to let everyone in your LAN change things again.
auth.not_writable: The folder data/office is missing or not writable — the agent creates it when it starts.
auth.new: New PIN (4 to 64 characters, digits or letters)
auth.forgot: Forgot it? Delete data/office/auth.json on the server.
auth.mismatch: The two new PINs don't match.
auth.saved: PIN saved — other browsers are locked now
help.title: How the office works
help.office_text: Every member of staff looks after one part of your Unraid server. The reception shows what each of them has to report; the tabs at the top lead to their desks.
help.agent_text: The web page runs in an ordinary container and can't touch zfs, docker or Unraid's configuration. That's done by a small agent on the host. It runs as the second service of the stack, started by
help.dot_text: Green: the agent checked in within the last 70 seconds (it does so every 20). Red: it is not running — you see the last known state and nothing can be changed. Grey: still loading.
help.start_text: The page cannot start it: without the agent it can't reach the server at all. Docker starts it together with the office and restarts it if it stops. If the dot stays red, start the stack again in the Compose Manager.
help.languages_text: The office speaks your device's language if a translation exists, otherwise English. Adding a language means adding JSON files:
help.security_text: Keep the office in your LAN. Reading is open; changing things can be protected with a PIN (⋯ → PIN). The agent can do what root can do on the host, but it only accepts the actions the desks define and checks every request.
